title: Concept: Legacy digest via Digest::SHA1.hexdigest (crystal) — review required
description: In crystal, Digest::SHA1.hexdigest computes a legacy digest. The remedy is Digest::SHA256.hexdigest.
applicability: crystal codebases hashing with Digest::SHA1.hexdigest; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW severity.
